description: Trigger examples for every current StudyHub skill. Each skill has three positive examples and the other skills' examples as negatives.

skills.name: Academic Writing
positive_triggers: Critique the introduction of my research paper and tell me where I need citations
Help me structure an argumentative literature review outline comparing microservices and monoliths
Review my essay thesis statement and give me Socratic feedback on the flow
